newsitem.title: USA: DHL Airways launched Miami-Honduras freight charter.
newsitem.headline: DHL Airways launched Miami-Honduras freight charter.

text.p: DHL Airways says it has begun operating a new weekly cargo charter flight between Miami and San Pedro Sula, Honduras, for New York-based Antillas Air.
DHL said that from San Pedro Sula, the Douglas DC-7 freighter carries textiles and a mix of general freight.
From the U.S., shipments are mainly raw materials needed by local manufacturers in the Honduran industrial centre.

DHL also operates New York/Miami to Santo Domingo flights for Antillas, part of the former's efforts to maximize fleet utilization when aircraft are not required for overnight express operations. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
